test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

“What is Sonia saying?” said Rohit.

options.text: Rohit asked what was Sonia saying.
Rohit asked that what was Sonia saying.
Rohit asked what is Sonia saying.
Rohit asked what Sonia was saying.

solution:
The correct answer is** "Rohit asked what Sonia was saying."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the case of** Interrogative **sentences like this, “said” in Direct Speech is changed into “enquired (of)”, “wanted to know”, “asked”, etc.
 
• In Indirect speech, the** verb** is always placed **after **the **subject**, unlike in direct speech.
 
• For example:
 
 
• The teacher said to him, “What is your name?” (Direct Speech)
 
• The teacher asked him what his name was. (Indirect Speech)
 
 
 
• Hence, 'is Soniya saying' is changed into 'Sonia was saying'. (verb is placed after the subject in the Indirect Speech).
 
• Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the **Present Continuous tense**. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the **Past Continuous tense**.

**So the correct sentence is**- *Rohit asked what Sonia was saying.*
